Name: CP One Eyed Willy
Author: supergeektuber
Description:
[center][b][/b][/center][left][b][/b][/left][center][left][b]One Eyed Willy:[/b]
My friend made a joke about how Willy should be One Eyed Willy, so I made my first mod Ever. I edited his portrait and sprite to have an eyepatch, and edited his name in the NPCDispositons.xnb file to "One Eyed Willy.

[b]Requirements:
[/b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

[b]Installation:
[/b][list]
[*]Download the .zip file
[*]Unzip to the Mods folder in the Stardew Valley directory
[/list][/left][/center]

Downloads.Description: A mod that changes Willy's name to "One Eyed Willy" and adds and eyepatch to his sprite and Portrait.
